detail.longDescription: NVIDIA released the full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform as open source on Oct 13. Worth noting: KAI Scheduler can be adopted alone, and fractional GPUs now rely on CUDA 13.4 native support rather than the old proprietary code. The NGC Community build has no NVIDIA support. https:// developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvid ia-runai-is-now-open-source-as-part-of-nvidia-dsx-ai-factory-platform/ # opensource # kubernetes # AI # MLOps
